headline: US ANTIMONY AND RARE EARTH STOCKS SURGE 11% IN SINGLE SESSION — Critical Metals Climbs 8%; Broad Sector Bid Lifts UAMY, USAR, CRIT Simultaneously
snippet: United States Antimony (UAMY) and USA Rare Earth (USAR) each surged 11% on October 27 as a broad sector bid lifted critical minerals equities across antimony, magnets, and Greenland rare earth names. Critical Metals climbed 8% in the same session — the coordinated move suggests renewed institutional interest in the U.S. domestic critical minerals supply chain rather than a company-specific catalyst.

headline: SLAM WRAPS GOODWIN PROGRAM WITH DISCOVERY 2,000M FROM KNOWN ZONE — GW26-33 Returns 1.53% CuEq Over 14.45m; New Bathurst Camp Copper-Nickel-Cobalt Footprint (TSXV:SXL)
snippet: SLAM Exploration (TSXV:SXL) completed its 2026 Goodwin copper-nickel-cobalt drill program with a new discovery approximately 2,000 metres northwest of the Logan Zone — hole GW26-33 returned 1.53% copper-equivalent over 14.45 metres, with separate mineralization identified at 0.44% CuEq over 43.1 metres. The discovery expands the known footprint across the 14,000-hectare Goodwin project in the Bathurst Mining Camp of New Brunswick, and is accompanied by a new company presentation at the 2026 New Orleans Investment Conference.

headline: TECK STRIKE ENTERS DAY FOUR AT CANADA'S BIGGEST COPPER MINE — 1,200 USW Workers at Highland Valley; Q3 Report Due Oct. 29 as Moly Target Hangs in Balance
snippet: USW Local 7619's 1,200-plus workers at Teck Resources' Highland Valley Copper operation near Logan Lake, B.C. — Canada's largest open-pit copper mine — have been on strike since October 24, after their collective agreement expired September 30. Teck says contingency plans are in place, but a prolonged work stoppage threatens both copper and molybdenum output targets heading into the company's Q3 earnings release scheduled for October 29.

headline: MIDNIGHT SUN'S DUMBWA COPPER ZONE MORE THAN TWICE AS WIDE AS MODELLED — 76 Holes, 17,373m Confirm District-Scale System in Zambia; New Rigs Drilling East (CSE:MMA)
snippet: Midnight Sun Mining (CSE:MMA) reported that the east-west width of copper mineralization at its Dumbwa deposit in Zambia is more than twice as wide as prior geological models predicted, based on 76 drill holes totalling 17,373 metres. With five rigs continuing to expand the deposit northward along strike and laterally to the east and west, the revised geometry significantly increases the potential tonnage of what the company describes as a large-scale near-surface copper system.

headline: ALEX METALS HITS CU-AU VMS IN SOUTHEAST ALASKA — KY26-009 Returns 11.7m at 1.71% Cu, 1.92 g/t Au; 6 of 8 Holes Hit Mineralisation, New Target Found 2km West (TSXV:ALX)
snippet: Alex Metals (TSXV:ALX) reported its first drill results from the KSO project in Southeast Alaska, with hole KY26-009 returning 11.7 metres at 1.71% copper and 1.92 g/t gold from 24.6 metres depth — a VMS-style intercept in a district that hosts the historic Khayyam and Stumble-On deposits. Six of eight holes drilled to date hit copper-gold mineralisation, and the company has identified a new target approximately 2 kilometres west of the primary drilling area.

headline: DISTRICT-SCALE COPPER-GOLD SYSTEM IDENTIFIED AT NORTH GAWLER CRATON — Grab Samples Return 31% Cu, 1.07 g/t Au; Great Plains Metals' Partner Eyes 2027 Drilling in South Australia (ASX:GPM)
snippet: Great Plains Metals' (ASX:GPM) South Australian joint-venture partner completed a first field campaign at the North Gawler Craton project, with selective grab samples from historical workings at the Coominaree prospect returning peak values of 31.1% copper, 1.07 g/t gold, and 39.5 g/t silver. The company describes the target as district-scale and plans a maiden drilling program in late 2026 or early 2027 — note that grab samples are selective and do not represent average grade.

headline: AXEL REE PRODUCES FIRST HIGH-GRADE RARE EARTH CARBONATE FROM IN-SITU RECOVERY — ISR Column Testwork at Woolrich Brazil Validates Low-Cost Development Pathway (ASX:AXL)
snippet: Axel REE (ASX:AXL) produced its first high-grade mixed rare earth carbonate from in-situ recovery column leach testwork at the Woolrich deposit within the Caladão project in Brazil, achieving 560 ppm soluble total rare earth oxide (TREO) and a 39% proportion of medium and heavy rare earth oxides. The result confirms what the company calls a low-acid, low-cost ISR pathway for the 128 Mt Woolrich deposit — a potential advantage over conventional hard-rock rare earth extraction.

headline: KINROSS Q3 TOMORROW, BIG GOLD MINERS SEASON OPENS — Street Sees $0.59 EPS on $2.11B Revenue; Agnico, Barrick to Follow Through November
snippet: Kinross Gold reports its Q3 2026 financial results after market close on October 28, opening a major gold miner earnings season that will include Agnico Eagle, Barrick Gold, IAMGOLD and Alamos Gold through early November. The Street consensus for Kinross stands at $0.59 non-GAAP EPS and $2.11 billion in revenue — the results arrive with gold near $4,000/oz and miners trading 30-40% below their 2026 highs, setting up a potential 'buy the earnings' or 'sell the news' decision for retail investors.

headline: GOLD AT $4,000 AND 26% BELOW ITS RECORD — Can October Still Deliver the Breakout Retail Investors Have Been Waiting For?
snippet: Canadian Mining Report examines whether the October gold market — with spot sitting near $4,000 and approximately 26% below its January 2026 record close of $5,405 — can still mount a meaningful breakout before year-end. The piece argues that the fundamental drivers (central bank buying, de-dollarisation, deficit spending) remain intact, but that a seller zone near $4,400 and the Fed's rate path are acting as near-term caps on a metal that has already delivered extraordinary gains.

headline: GOLD AND SILVER CHARTS HINT AT REPEAT OF 2026'S SHARPEST SELLOFF — Technical Patterns Flag Key Risk Levels as Fed Decision Arrives Wednesday
snippet: A technical analysis from Forex.com flags chart patterns on gold and silver that closely resemble the setup that preceded 2026's sharpest precious metals selloff earlier in the year, with the Fed's October rate decision arriving Wednesday as the potential catalyst. The piece identifies specific support and resistance levels retail investors should monitor — and notes that a break below key gold support near $3,950 could accelerate selling in junior miners that have already underperformed the metal significantly.
